lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Single real formed fold of about 81.5 deg (included angle 98.5 deg) between the large two-hole flange and the narrow windowed flange. I took perpendicular sections at 25%, 50% and 75% along the line. In all three the label point sits on the outer-skin apex: the nearest surface point is 0.075, 0.016 and 0.098 mm away. Near the line, the outer skin is at v of about 0 and the inner skin is about 1.95 mm in along the bisector, which matches the 1.97 mm thickness. The line runs parallel to the fold: the side view (t vs bisector) is flat along its whole length. The fold zone spans t of -0.7 to 70.5 mm and the line spans 0 to 70.17 mm, so coverage is about 99%. The window sits inside the narrow flange and does not interrupt the fold.
